terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These rules explain how digiworlds works. We wrote them in plain words. By using the service, you accept these terms.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: digiworlds is operated by {operatorName}, an individual based in Colombia.
You can write to us at {supportEmail}.

sections.heading: 2. Adults only
paragraphs: You must be 18 or older to use digiworlds.

sections.heading: 3. The service
paragraphs: digiworlds is a digital service for practicing English pronunciation. It is delivered online.
It is not a school and it does not give certificates.

sections.heading: 4. No guaranteed results
paragraphs: We do not promise that you will reach a specific English level. Your progress depends on how much you practice.

sections.heading: 5. Plans and payments
paragraphs: There is a free plan and a Premium plan at US$ {price} per month.
Payments are processed by Polar, our merchant of record. Polar also collects and pays sales tax.
Polar's checkout terms also apply to your purchase.

sections.heading: 6. Auto-renewal
paragraphs: Premium renews every month until you cancel.

sections.heading: 7. Cancellation
paragraphs: You can cancel anytime. Use "Manage subscription" in the app (Polar's customer portal) or email us at {supportEmail}.
You keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.

sections.heading: 8. Refunds
paragraphs: You get a full refund in the first 14 days from your first payment. The details are in the refund policy.

sections.heading: 9. Acceptable use
paragraphs: Use digiworlds for yourself only.
Do not share your account with other people and do not abuse the service.

sections.heading: 10. Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms. We will always show the date of the last update.
If a change is important, we will tell you by email.

sections.heading: 11. Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of Colombia.

sections.heading: 12. Language
paragraphs: These terms exist in Spanish and English. If they differ, the Spanish version prevails.

sections.heading: Full refund in the first 14 days
paragraphs: If you ask for a refund within 14 days of your first payment, we give you everything back.
Email {supportEmail} with the email address of your account.

sections.heading: After 14 days
paragraphs: After the first 14 days there is no refund for the current period.
You can cancel to stop the next renewal. You keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.

sections.heading: How the refund is paid
paragraphs: Refunds are issued through Polar, to the original payment method.
Your bank may take several days to show it.

sections.heading: Language
paragraphs: This policy exists in Spanish and English. If they differ, the Spanish version prevails.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Here we explain what data we use, why, and who we share it with.

sections.heading: 1. Who is responsible
paragraphs: {operatorName}, Colombia. Email: {supportEmail}.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: We collect this data:
items: Your account email and name, including when you sign in with "Continue with Google".
Your learning progress and pronunciation scores.
Your notification subscription, if you allow reminders.
Basic technical data we need for bot protection.

sections.heading: 3. Your voice
paragraphs: Your voice is sent to Microsoft Azure to score your pronunciation and is then discarded.
It is only stored if you turn on "Save my recordings". That option is off by default. Stored recordings are kept in Cloudflare R2.
The spoken tips in Spanish are pre-generated by Azure and never use your voice.

sections.heading: 4. Why we use your data
paragraphs: We use it to:
items: Run the service and show your progress.
Send you sign-in links and reminders.
Handle payments and support.
Protect against bots.
Measure our ads.

sections.heading: 5. Providers we use
paragraphs: These companies help us run the service:
items: Supabase: accounts and progress data.
Microsoft Azure Speech: pronunciation scoring and spoken tips.
Vercel: app hosting.
Polar: payments, sales tax and the subscription portal.
Cloudflare: DNS, this website and its cookieless statistics, R2 storage (app audio and saved recordings), and Turnstile (bot protection).
Google: "Continue with Google" sign-in.
An email provider (for example, Resend): sign-in links.
Browser push services (Apple, Google, Mozilla): reminders.
Meta and TikTok: ad measurement (pixels and server events). They only receive events such as visit, sign-up, payment and purchase. They never receive audio, scores or sounds.

sections.heading: 6. We do not sell your data
paragraphs: We do not sell your data for money.

Sharing ad events with Meta and TikTok may count as "sharing" under some US state laws. You can opt out with the "Do not sell or share my personal information" link, or with your browser's Global Privacy Control signal.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies
paragraphs: We use these cookies. We do not use product analytics such as Google Analytics.
items: Sign-in session cookies (needed).
Turnstile cookies (bot protection).
Meta and TikTok ad cookies (turned off by the opt-out above or by GPC).

sections.heading: 8. Cancelling
paragraphs: You can cancel from "Manage subscription" in the app, which opens Polar's customer portal, or by email.

sections.heading: 9. Deleting your data
paragraphs: Email {supportEmail} and we delete your account, your progress and any saved recordings.

sections.heading: 10. Minors
paragraphs: The service is for adults 18 or older only.

sections.heading: 11. Changes and language
paragraphs: We may update this policy. We will always show the date of the last update.
This policy exists in Spanish and English. If they differ, the Spanish version prevails.
